autolinking.//: @expo/dom-webview autolinks by default but nothing in this app imports it ('use dom' components need it) — pulling in androidx.webview would be dead weight for a 50-70MB budget, so it stays excluded. @expo/ui was ALSO excluded here until 2026-08-19: expo-router 57.0.13+ added its own Android Stack-toolbar feature that imports @expo/ui unconditionally at module load (layouts/stack-utils/toolbar/*), reachable on every launch via Stack's own module graph regardless of whether a screen renders a toolbar — excluding it left requireNativeModule('ExpoUI') with nothing to find, a hard crash ~1s after open on every standalone build. Do not re-add @expo/ui to this list while expo-router depends on it.
